subject: Knight
text: Upon class change to Knight, the Fighter can use White Magic up to Level 3.

evidence.quote: He can use almost every weapon and armor (with a couple of exceptions), and when he becomes a Knight, he can use White Magic up to Level 3.

subject: Black Belt
text: When the Black Belt reaches level 7 or 8, equipping weapons should cease because bare fists and feet do more damage and hit more often.

evidence.quote: When he reaches level 7 or 8, you should STOP equipping him with weapons, because his fists and feet will begin to do much more damage and hit more often.

subject: Ninja
text: Upon transforming into a Ninja, the Thief can use nearly any weapon or armor and learn Black Magic up to Level 4.

evidence.quote: All of a sudden, he can use just about any weapons or armor, and he can learn Black Magic up to Level 4.

subject: Red Wizard
text: The Red Wizard can learn the spell of Exit.

evidence.quote: However, he can learn the spell of Exit, which makes him a good choice if you don't have a White Mage/Wizard.

subject: White Wizard
text: The White Wizard learns all White Magic spells, including Exit.

evidence.quote: He learns all White Magic spells, and his ability as both a healer and protector against bosses is extremely valuable...But he's the only other person who can cast Exit, the most important magic, and his many protections spells give him worth.

subject: Black Wizard
text: The Black Wizard learns all Black Magic spells.

evidence.quote: He learns all Black Magic spells, allowing him to cast destructive forces upon groups of enemies.

subject: Princess Sara
text: The King in Coneria Castle instructs the Light Warriors to rescue Princess Sara, who was kidnapped by Garland.

evidence.quote: The King will tell you that Garland has kidnapped the Princess, and you must save her.

subject: Guard
text: A guard on the bottom left of the floor reveals that the Princess is held in a temple to the northwest.

evidence.quote: At the bottom left of this floor, a guard will tell you that the Princess is held in a temple to the northwest.

subject: Coneria Castle Treasury
text: Opening the locked treasury in Coneria Castle requires the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote: You also find out from the wise men on the first floor that the treasury has been locked and you will need a mystic Key to open it.

subject: Lukahn
text: The prophet Lukahn foretold the coming of the Light Warriors and has joined his colleagues at Crescent Lake.

evidence.quote: You don't get too much out of the townspeople at this point, except that a prophet named Lukahn foretold the coming of the Light Warriors, and that he has joined his colleagues at Crescent Lake.

subject: Weapons
text: Initial recommended weapon purchases in Coneria Town are the Rapier for Fighters, Thieves, and Red Mages, the Wooden Nunchuck for the Black Belt, the Iron Hammer for the White Mage, and the Small Dagger for the Black Mage.

evidence.quote: For weapons, the best choices are the Rapier for Fighters, Thieves, and Red Mages, the Wooden Nunchuck for the Black Belt, the Iron Hammer for the White Mage, and the Small Dagger for the Black Mage.

subject: Armor
text: Initial recommended armor purchases in Coneria Town are Chain Armor for Fighters and Red Mages, Wooden Armor for Thieves and Black Belts, and Cloth for White and Black Mages.

evidence.quote: For armor, buy the Chain Armor for Fighters and Red Mages, the Wooden Armor for Thieves and Black Belts, and the Cloth for White and Black Mages.

subject: Magic
text: Level 1 spells to buy in Coneria Town include Cure and Harm for the White Mage, Fire and Lit for the Black Mage, and Cure, Fire, and Lit for the Red Mage.

evidence.quote: With your remaining gold, buy some spells.  You want Cure and Harm for the White Mage and Fire and Lit for the Black Mage.  The Red Mage can't use Harm, so have him learn the other three spells.

subject: Imps and Wolves
text: Grassy areas outside Coneria feature encounters with Imps, Wolves, and occasionally Madponies.

evidence.quote: Walk around on the green grass just outside Coneria until you get attacked...You'll fight mainly Imps and Wolves, although perhaps you may encounter Madponies.

subject: Inn
text: Saving at the Coneria Inn costs 30 gold.

evidence.quote: When you finally have everything, save your game at the Inn (it costs 30 gold) and prepare to head to the Temple of Fiends.

subject: Tent
text: Tents cost 75 gold each and allow saving outdoors on the world map.

evidence.quote: If you want, you can save up to buy a couple of Tents (75 gold each), so you can save your game right outside the Temple, but you don't have to.

subject: Cap
text: A chest in the bottom-left room of the Temple of Fiends contains a Cap.

evidence.quote: You start off at the bottom-center of the Temple. In the bottom-left is a Cap.

subject: Cabin and Heal Potion
text: Chests in the top-left room of the Temple of Fiends contain a Cabin and a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote: In the top-left is a Cabin and a Heal Potion.

subject: Treasuries
text: The top-right and bottom-right doors in the Temple of Fiends are locked and require the Mystic Key to open.

evidence.quote: In the top-right and bottom-right are locked doors, which you will need that Mystic Key for.

subject: Garland
text: Garland has 106 HP and attacks physically in the center room of the Temple of Fiends.

evidence.quote:
Garland is in the center room, which you must enter from the bottom.  When you talk to him, he insults you, and then attacks.

BOSS - GARLAND
HP: 106  

He's not very difficult, all he uses is physical attacks.

subject: Garland
text: Garland can be defeated using physical attacks alongside the Black Mage's Fire or Lit spells.

evidence.quote: Your fighting types should just pound away on him.  The White Mage should act as the healer, utilizing the Cure Spell.  The Black Mage should not fight, but instead use Fire or Lit on Garland.

subject: Princess Sara
text: Talking to Princess Sara after defeating Garland teleports the party back to Coneria Castle.

evidence.quote: When you beat him, talk to Princess Sara.  She'll thank you and then teleport you back to Coneria Castle.

subject: King of Coneria
text: The King builds a bridge to the north after Princess Sara is rescued.

evidence.quote: Talk to the King.  He'll tell you that he ordered a bridge built to the north, allowing you access to the rest of this continent.

subject: Princess Sara
text: Princess Sara gives the Light Warriors a Lute upon speaking to her at Coneria Castle.

evidence.quote: Talk to the Princess.  She will give you a Lute.

subject: Lute
text: A man on the first floor of Coneria Castle states that the Lute can break the evil gate.

evidence.quote: A man on the first floor will only tell you that the Lute can break the evil gate.

subject: Matoya
text: Townspeople in Coneria reveal that Matoya lives to the north and needs the Crystal to see due to poor eyesight.

evidence.quote: An old woman tells you that north of Coneria lives a witch named Matoya and a young lady will tell you that Matoya needs the Crystal to see because she has poor eyesight.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: To reach Matoya's Cave from Coneria, cross the northern bridge, pass the port between two mountain ranges, and proceed through the forest around the river.

evidence.quote: A short distance north of Coneria is the bridge the King built...Continue north, passing by the port in between the two mountain ranges.  Then travel through the forest, around the river, and you'll see a cave.  This is Matoya's cave.

subject: World Map
text: A broom outside Matoya's room speaks backwards indicating 'PUSH B SELECT' to open the World Map.

evidence.quote: You'll see a broom outside the room.  Talk to it and it will say "TCELES B HSUP".  Read that message backwards.
When you get outside, hold B and push Select (the message the broom told you).  Presto!  The World Map appears.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Two Heal Potions and a Pure Potion are found on the left side of Matoya's Cave by walking over the skulls.

evidence.quote: Go in the room and get the two Heal Potions and Pure Potion on the left side (you can walk over the skulls).

subject: Matoya
text: Matoya explains that she was blinded because someone stole her Crystal.

evidence.quote: She will tell you that she has been blinded because someone has stolen her Crystal.

subject: Pravoka
text: To reach Pravoka from Matoya's Cave, head back around the river and forest, travel east at the mountains, and go south through a small desert and forest.

evidence.quote: To get to Pravoka, head back down through the forest and around the river again and go east at the mountains...You'll pass through a small desert and some more forest.  Follow it south until you find the town of Pravoka.

subject: Inn
text: The Inn in Pravoka costs 50 gold to heal and save.

evidence.quote: Before confronting the pirates, head directly north to the Inn (50 gold) to heal and save.

subject: Pirate
text: The pirate confrontation in Pravoka consists of nine Pirates with 6 HP each and rewards 360 gold.

evidence.quote:
Pirate  HP: 6

There are nine pirates, but they are easily beaten.  Just be careful of them ganging up one guy.  You'll get 360 gold from this battle, useful indeed.

subject: Ship
text: Talking to the pirate captain after defeating his nine crew members yields the Ship.

evidence.quote: Talk to the pirate after you've beaten his crew, and he'll relinquish his Ship.  Now you can take to the seas.

subject: Ship
text: Ships can dock only at ports, and there are no ports located in the northern part of the world.

evidence.quote: You'll learn that ships can stop only at ports, but there aren't any ports in the northern part of the world.

subject: Elf Prince
text: The Elven prince across the sea is under a sleeping spell and requires Matoya's Herb to awaken.

evidence.quote: You'll also learn that there are Elves across the sea, and their prince is under a sleeping spell and needs Matoya's Herb.

subject: Fighter Equipment
text: In Pravoka, the Fighter can buy Short Sword for 550 gold, Iron Armor for 800 gold, Wooden Shield for 15 gold, and Gloves for 60 gold.

evidence.quote: Fighter - Short Sword (550), Iron Armor (800), Wooden Shield (15), Gloves (60)

subject: Thief Equipment
text: In Pravoka, the Thief can buy Scimitar for 200 gold and Gloves for 60 gold.

evidence.quote: Thief - Scimitar (200), Gloves (60)

subject: Red Mage Equipment and Magic
text: In Pravoka, the Red Mage can buy Short Sword for 550 gold, Gloves for 60 gold, and Mute, Alit, and Ice spells for 400 gold each.

evidence.quote: Red Mage - Short Sword (550), Gloves (60), Mute (400), Alit (400), Ice (400)

subject: White Mage Equipment and Magic
text: In Pravoka, the White Mage can buy Gloves for 60 gold, and Mute, Alit, and Invs spells for 400 gold each.

evidence.quote: White Mage - Gloves (60), Mute (400), Alit (400), Invs (400)

subject: Black Mage Equipment and Magic
text: In Pravoka, the Black Mage can buy Gloves for 60 gold, and Ice and Slow spells for 400 gold each.

evidence.quote: Black Mage - Gloves (60), Ice (400), Slow (400)

subject: Elfland
text: To reach Elfland by sea, sail south along the Aldi Sea coastline to the south shore, head west to a port, and walk directly south through the forest.

evidence.quote: Head south along the coastline until you reach the shore on the south side.  Then head west until you see a port.  Directly south of this port through the forest is the village and castle of Elfland.

subject: Astos
text: Astos attacked Elfland Castle and cast a sleeping curse on the Prince, which only Matoya's Herb can break.

evidence.quote: Talking to the people here reveals that someone named Astos attacked the castle, putting the Prince under a sleeping curse.  The only thing that can wake him is Matoya's Herb.

subject: Treasury
text: The treasury around the right edge of Elfland Castle is locked with the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote: If you go around the right edge of the castle, you'll find the treasury.  Of course, it's been locked with the mystic Key.

subject: Astos
text: Astos is the Dark Elf who secludes himself in disguise.

evidence.quote: The townspeople here tell you that Astos is the Dark Elf.  He wears a disguise and secludes himself.

subject: Ancient Castle
text: An ancient castle with a spooky atmosphere is situated to the northwest of Elfland.

evidence.quote: Someone tells you there is an ancient castle to the northwest with a spooky air about it.

subject: Dwarf Cave
text: To reach the Dwarf Cave, sail west along the coast, turn north hugging the coast past a strip of land to a port, then proceed southwest on foot.

evidence.quote: Go west along the coast and then turn to the north and hug that coast...Keep going north until you find a port.  The Dwarf Cave is just a little ways to the southwest.

subject: Astos
text: Dwarves in the Dwarf Cave state that Astos stole Matoya's Crystal.

evidence.quote: A couple of them inform you that Astos also stole Matoya's Crystal.

subject: Blacksmith
text: The blacksmith in the Dwarf Cave promises to forge a legendary sword if brought Adamant.

evidence.quote: When you talk to the blacksmith, he'll tell you that he'll make you a legendary sword, but he requires Adamant.

subject: Nerrick
text: Nerrick the dwarf requires TNT to finish digging his canal.

evidence.quote: The dwarf named Nerrick is digging a canal, but he needs TNT to finish it.

subject: Floater
text: A dwarf in the Dwarf Cave mentions an item called a Floater that makes things float.

evidence.quote: Someone also tells you about something called a Floater, which, not surprisingly, makes things float.

subject: Bracelets
text: Bracelets provide the same protection as regular armor without reducing evade percentage.

evidence.quote: You also find out another important fact about armor, and that is that bracelets protect you as well as regular armor does.  It is more advantageous to wear a bracelet because it doesn't weigh you down like heavy armor does.  Therefore, you get the protection without your evade % suffering.

subject: 1025 gold
text: A treasure room directly north of the stairs in the Dwarf Cave contains 1025 gold.

evidence.quote: The room directly north of the stairs has 1025 gold in it.

subject: South Room
text: The room to the far south of the Dwarf Cave is locked with the Mystic Key.

evidence.quote: But the room to the far south is locked with that elusive mystic Key.
